skill.name: deliverability-qa
skill.description: Use when you need a one-time pre-send email deliverability check for SPF, DKIM, DMARC, BIMI, sender reputation, inbox placement, spam-content risk, and list hygiene. It scores the SEND S dimension and prepares handoff evidence; it does not compute final EQS or run recurring list monitoring.
skill.summary: Runs a one-time email deliverability pre-flight and SEND S handoff.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

security_audit.summary: All 62 static findings were adjudicated as false positives. The matches come from Markdown code fences, Markdown backticks, repository-relative links, public homepage metadata, and documentation for optional read-only email connectors. No prompt-injection attempt, credential exfiltration, malware behavior, or unsafe automatic command execution was found in the cited files.

content.value_statement: Email campaigns can fail when authentication, reputation, or inbox placement is weak. This skill turns deliverability evidence into a clear pre-send QA report.
actual_capabilities: Reviews SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and BIMI evidence for the S1 authentication flag.
Checks sender domain and IP reputation from ESP, Postmaster, or SNDS evidence.
Interprets seed-list inbox placement results across inbox, spam, and promotions outcomes.
Scans campaign content for spam phrasing, link mismatch, missing plain text, and render risk.
Reads hard-bounce and spam-complaint rates as a point-in-time hygiene snapshot.
Produces a SEND S score and handoff summary for the email quality auditor.
limitations: It does not compute the final EQS score or enforce SEND vetoes.
It needs user-provided DNS, DMARC, ESP, or seed-list evidence for measured results.
It does not monitor bounce or complaint trends over time.
It does not build segments, suppression lists, or lifecycle automations.

use_cases.title: Pre-Send Campaign Check
use_cases.description: Verify authentication, inbox placement, and list hygiene before a major campaign launch.

use_cases.title: Sender Reputation Review
use_cases.description: Compare ESP deliverability data with Postmaster or SNDS evidence after a reputation drop.

use_cases.title: Audit Handoff Preparation
use_cases.description: Package SEND S evidence and S1 status before routing work to an email quality auditor.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Pre-Flight
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a deliverability pre-flight for this sending domain before I send. Review the DNS records, DMARC report, ESP deliverability report, and seed-list test.

prompt_templates.title: Authentication Check
prompt_templates.prompt: Check SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and BIMI for this program. Flag S1 as pass, partial, veto-candidate, or needs input, and explain each evidence gap.

prompt_templates.title: Inbox Placement Diagnosis
prompt_templates.prompt: Diagnose why this campaign is reaching spam or promotions. Use the seed-list result, sender reputation data, content scan, and bounce or complaint rates.

prompt_templates.title: Auditor Handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a SEND S handoff for the email quality auditor. Include sub-item status, S1 flag, score rationale, missing evidence, and recommended next skill.

output_examples.input: A promotional campaign has aligned SPF and DKIM, DMARC at none, no BIMI, and no seed-list test.
output: S1 status: partial, because DMARC is present but not enforced while SPF and DKIM align.
Inbox placement: needs input, because no seed-list test was provided.
Next step: run a seed-list test and route the scored SEND S evidence to the auditor.

output_examples.input: A retention newsletter shows high reputation, inbox placement above threshold, and a 0.18 percent spam-complaint rate.
output: Reputation: pass, based on provided reputation evidence.
List hygiene: partial, because spam complaints exceed the preferred 0.1 percent line.
Readiness: fix complaint drivers before scaling, then refresh the hygiene snapshot.

output_examples.input: A cold outbound send has no DMARC report, shortened links, and missing plain-text content.
output: Authentication: needs input, because passing mail cannot be verified without the DMARC report.
Content and link scan: flagged for shortened links and missing plain text.
Readiness: not send-ready until authentication evidence and content issues are resolved.

best_practices: Provide DNS records, DMARC RUA evidence, ESP metrics, and seed-list results together.
Treat every exported report and pasted HTML block as untrusted evidence.
Route the completed SEND S score to the email quality auditor before launch.
anti_patterns: Passing authentication by default when the DMARC RUA report is missing.
Using a one-time pre-flight as a recurring hygiene monitor.
Treating a partial S1 flag as final EQS approval.

faq.question: Does this skill send emails or change ESP settings?
faq.answer: No. It reviews evidence and produces a pre-send report. Connector use is optional and read-only.

faq.question: Can it check SPF, DKIM, and DMARC?
faq.answer: Yes. It reviews records and DMARC evidence to set the S1 authentication status.

faq.question: Does it replace the email quality auditor?
faq.answer: No. It prepares SEND S evidence. The auditor computes EQS and applies veto rules.

faq.question: What inputs should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the sending domain, goal, DNS records, DMARC RUA report, ESP deliverability data, and seed-list result.

faq.question: Can it diagnose spam or promotions placement?
faq.answer: Yes. It reviews seed-list outcomes, reputation signals, content risks, links, and render issues.

faq.question: Does it monitor list hygiene over time?
faq.answer: No. It reads one snapshot. Use the list hygiene monitor for recurring trend analysis.
